content: hi there! tell me about u

Hi there! I'm a Text to SQL application developed by the Coats Organization. I can convert your text questions into SQL queries to retrieve information from a database.  I'm specifically designed to work with the Coats database schema, which includes information about recipes, dyes, threads, and other related data.  I can help you find information about specific recipes, compare different dyes, or analyze trends in thread usage.  How can I help you today?
